# ankra_backup_vaults (Data Source)

Lists the backup vaults in the provider's project. Keys are never listed. The counterpart of `ankra backup vaults list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_backup_vaults" "all" {}

output "ready_vaults" {
  value = [for vault in data.ankra_backup_vaults.all.vaults : vault.name if vault.status == "ready"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `vaults` (Attributes List) Backup vaults. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vaults))

<a id="nestedatt--vaults"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vaults`

Read-Only:

- `bucket` (String) Bucket name.
- `credential_id` (String) Credential a provisioned vault was created with.
- `endpoint` (String) S3 endpoint.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the vault.
- `kind` (String) `customer_s3` or `ankra_provisioned`.
- `name` (String) Vault name.
- `path_style` (Boolean) Whether the bucket is addressed path-style.
- `provider` (String) Object-storage provider.
- `region` (String) Bucket region.
- `status` (String) `provisioning`, `ready` or `error`.
